description: This file defines the class 'StateCheckerDirectoryIterator' within the SuiteCRM namespace. The class extends RecursiveFilterIterator to create a directory iterator that filters for readable directories. It provides a constructor that initializes the iteration with a given path, verifying its validity, and an 'accept' method to include only readable directories.

classes.name: StateCheckerDirectoryIterator
classes.description: A readable directory iterator that filters for directories only.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a directory path, checking if it's valid and readable. Uses RecursiveDirectoryIterator with SKIP_DOTS flag if a string path is provided.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if the current item is a readable directory, used for filtering during iteration.
